scientific_integrity.claim: Exact one-vertex degree law, fixed-original-degree leaf extremizers, and uniform quantitative Poisson approximation for uniform rook-graph spanning trees
scientific_integrity.limitations: Does not assert novelty of the universal Poisson limit, joint degree laws or independent priority. General transfer-current frameworks can be specialized; a historical exact specialization may have been overlooked. Finite checks are not infinite proof.

title: Exact Poisson-binomial rook-tree degrees and sharp fixed-degree leaf extrema
